public_rationale: His figure is simple arithmetic on the reported numbers. Reporting citing The Information gives Q1 2026 revenue of about $5.7bn and an adjusted operating margin of -122%, excluding stock-based compensation. That works out to an adjusted loss of about $6.95bn. Later reporting from shareholder documents put the full operating loss at $9.3bn, with stock pay over $2.3bn. The two figures reconcile ($6.95bn + $2.3bn ≈ $9.3bn). The net loss was over $21.3bn. That bears out his hedge that losses could be higher. His other hedge, that revenue might be lower, did not come true: $5.7bn was confirmed. Because that part was framed as only 'quite possible,' it does not overturn the core figure.
limitations: All figures are secondhand press reports of internal documents, not audited filings.
The basis of the $9.3bn operating loss (GAAP or not) is not stated.
